node.title: Paper D v13.2 near-rational pair proximity
node.statement: For a linear code C and distinct finite slopes z1,z2, if u+z_i v=c_i+eta_i with c_i in C and wt(eta_i)<=w, then an explicit codeword pair (cu,cv) agrees jointly with (u,v) outside supp(eta1) union supp(eta2), hence on at least n-2w coordinates. Under Paper D v13.2 thm:capfp-dichotomy's hypotheses, including 2w<=n-K, two nonzero-census slopes with d1<=w imply this pair-proximity conclusion. This does not pay support-wise MCA witnesses.
